content.thinking:
I'm going through each claim one by one, checking whether the source supports it. The first is about account pages failing for some shoppers on io-shop, which I'm marking as supported. The second is about an administrator enabling a new feature on the account page, and I'm treating that as the likely cause.

I'm working through the remaining claims: the response effort, the feature flag being turned off as how the incident ended, and that change still being in place. I'm also checking the proposed fix, PR #527, which is still a draft with nothing recorded after it.

supported.quote: An administrator switched on a new feature for the account page.
rows: Why, in plain words: An administrator switched on a new feature for the account page

supported.quote: It likely sent shoppers who had bought nothing this month through a calculation that divides by their number of purchases this month, and that calculation fails when the number is zero.
rows: Why, in plain words: An administrator switched on a new feature for the account page, and it likely sent shoppers who had bought nothing this month

Argus ended the incident by turning off the feature flag monthly-spend-feature.

Argus has also proposed a fix, PR #527. It is still a draft and has not been applied.

The fix it proposed: PR #527 (https://github.com/ohadraz/Argus-Demo-Target-App/pull/527) opened as a draft. The record holds nothing about it after that.
